It's been a fun 5-6 years, but today is my last day in the trenches. I've round tripped 6 figures, multiple times. 4 months ago, I had $350 k. Today, I have $50. I know what you're probably thinking, 'no need to announce your departure,' but I want to leave all my crypto friends with one last farewell and a piece of advice— This space moves fast. You may catch yourself thinking 'if I buy this and flip it, I can get more of the coin I have conviction in.' That was my downfall. Now the coins I have conviction in, I can't afford to buy. All it takes is one wrong trade. So I'm walking away for good, right before probably the biggest crypto szn in history. Not by choice, but because of bad decisions. Don't do what I did—Hold what you have conviction in, but don't be afraid to take some profits every now and then. You deserve that after all the time and effort you put into this space. Good luck to all the people I've met along the way. May your lives flourish and crypto bless you beyond your imagination. It was a fun ride. Take care everyone.
* Decide your exit by level, not hope.
